title: Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2609.05512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture

translated_title: 推理感知压缩：识别并保护脆弱推理电路以实现高能效的大语言模型部署
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型在部署过程中会产生巨大的能耗成本，然而当前的压缩方法对所有组件采用统一量化，存在损坏关键推理电路的风险。我们提出了一个推理感知的压缩框架，该框架在五个推理基准（GSM8K、FOLIO、MATH-500、ProofWriter 和 MuSiQue）上对量化条件进行基准测试，并进行硬件级 GPU 能耗测量；通过在留出的校准集上进行扰动扫描，对全部 196-224 对（层，投影）进行逐模块的 INT4 脆弱性分析，然后选择性地将最敏感的电路恢复为 FP16 精度。研究得出三项发现：第一，INT4 量化可能通过延长推理链而增加能耗，在 GSM8K 上 25% 的功率降低反而变成了净能耗增加；第二，脆弱性具有任务依赖性，注意力投影对数学推理更为关键，且敏感性模式因模型架构而异。
tldr: 本文提出一种推理感知压缩框架，通过识别量化最敏感的推理电路并选择性地将其恢复为FP16精度，揭示了INT4量化可能因延长推理链反而增加能耗的现象，从而在节能部署与保持推理能力之间实现平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reasoning-aware compression framework that identifies the most quantization-sensitive reasoning circuits and selectively restores them to FP16, revealing that INT4 quantization can paradoxically increase energy consumption by extending reasoning chains, thereby balancing energy-efficient deployment with preserved reasoning capability.
